summary: First full sweep: 68 openings at 29 hospitals and surgery centers, 29 of them strong or worth applying. No full-time mother-baby roles were open anywhere in range today.

43 new openings, 22 of them strong or worth applying. 4 closed. First sweep to include GI lab and pre-op-only roles. The independent surgery and endoscopy center search was cut short, so a few small centers may be missing. Fertility clinics added later in the day: 13 openings across 30 newly tracked clinics. Many fertility roles require ACLS at hire.
